findings.property: A vector query is admitted only after selected generation rule/device/dimension and live encoder identity match; text is encoded by the gate and identity is checked again before HNSW.
findings.negative_control: Bypassing the query gate with a same-dimensional wrong vector selects the decoy; admitted text query selects the target.

findings.limitation: No current serving caller injects the matching local query encoder; production paired model assets/profile and actual Legal corpus membership remain unestablished.
findings.note: Current paths therefore use text search/fallback or have no vector profile. The candidate does not claim LA-040 production closure.
